name: software-factory
description: Local software factory: plan, build, review and fix features with fresh-context Claude Code agents.

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U factory factory
scripts.metrics: docker compose exec -T db psql -U factory factory -P pager=off < scripts/metrics.sql
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @factory/server dev" "pnpm --filter @factory/web dev"
scripts.start: pnpm db:up && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @factory/server start
